sources.supports: PTU quota is not a universal TPM conversion and is not GPU count

sources.title: NVIDIA Megatron-LM tensor-parallel formulation
sources.supports: Column-parallel first MLP projection followed by row-parallel second projection and forward AllReduce; used only for original explanatory diagrams, not training benchmark coordinates

sources.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding, ICML 2023
sources.supports: Exact speculative sampling and E[committed tokens]=(1-alpha^(gamma+1))/(1-alpha) under simplified i.i.d. acceptance; teaching cycle costs are user assumptions, not the paper's measured speedups

sources.title: vLLM Automatic Prefix Caching
sources.supports: Exact shared-prefix KV reuse skips repeated prefill; it does not generally shorten output decode time and support/layout is version-dependent

sources.title: vLLM LlamaAttention KV-head tensor-parallel implementation
sources.supports: Query-head divisibility; KV partition below KV-head count, replication above it, with num_kv_heads=max(1,total_num_kv_heads/TP)

sources.title: vLLM MLA cache layout implementation, indexed revision
sources.supports: get_kv_cache_config uses num_kv_heads=1 and max_tp_shards=1; opaque MLA layouts may require state_content_bytes rather than head_size*dtype. Reference replication is not a promise for every backend

sources.title: vLLM V1 metrics definitions
sources.supports: Per-output-event ITL differs from per-request TPOT; Prometheus records TPOT zero for at most one output token while serving benchmark statistics can exclude those requests

sources.title: NVIDIA AIPerf project
sources.supports: Serving-endpoint profiling with concurrency/request-rate/trace modes and explicit tokenizer; no example benchmark coordinates copied

sources.title: NVIDIA GenAI-Perf documentation and deprecation notice
sources.supports: Official documentation says new-feature development is phased out and recommends AIPerf; reviewed2026-11-21

sources.title: Microsoft Foundry Azure OpenAI quota definitions
sources.supports: Direct page reviewed2026-11-21 says actual input/generated tokens, not configured maximum-output reservation; RPM can use1/10-second windows and headers guide retries. Older indexed summaries differ. Documentation verification is not a serving-endpoint test or an established service-transition date

sources.title: Microsoft Foundry classic quota live documentation
sources.supports: Direct classic-page read agrees with current actual-token and short-window RPM rules, despite older search-index snippets. PTU utilization evaluation is separate; no subscription quota or regional capacity is queried

sources.title: Dynamo disaggregated-serving layout/transport requirements, indexed revision
sources.supports: Same model/dtype/block size/KV layout required; CUDA IPC transport has namespace constraints. Indexed recipes also show model-specific TP/MTP restrictions; release compatibility must be separately checked

sources.title: vLLM NIXL connector topology constraints, indexed revision
sources.supports: Pull/push and PCP/DCP/TP combinations have explicit support limits; transferable layout and topology cannot be inferred from total GPU count

sources.title: PCI-SIG PCIe specification webinar
sources.supports: Gen3/4/5 NRZ rates8/16/32GT/s with128b/130b encoding; Gen6/7 PAM4/FLIT need different accounting. Actual negotiated lanes/generation must be measured

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX H100 SuperPOD Network Fabrics RA
sources.supports: Rail-aligned groups, same-rail locality and cross-rail/spine paths; storage/compute/management fabrics and allocation must not be conflated

sources.title: NCCL-tests count and bandwidth implementations, indexed revision
sources.supports: AllGather/ReduceScatter/fixed AllToAll GetBw multiply actual API count bytes by ranks; AllReduce does not. Variable AllToAllv uses max send/recv byte counts, not a mean

sources.title: Cisco8000 Priority Flow Control headroom and threshold guide
sources.supports: Headroom absorbs traffic after pause assertion; ECN precedes pause threshold and vendor line-card buffer limits are explicit. Page uses an original engineering headroom floor, not Cisco configuration values

sources.title: W3C WCAG2.2 selected readability and operation criteria
sources.supports: Selected text/non-text contrast, reflow, keyboard and concise status-message checks; these checks are not a full conformance certification

calculation_boundaries: All examples, SLA targets, Pareto curves and P99curves are synthetic educational scenarios, not GPU measurements. PD request-P99 TPOT uses200 request means; pooled-P99 ITL uses the same6200 gaps.
Nominal memory GB uses 10^9 bytes; replace with actual engine-visible usable bytes before procurement.
Ideal aggregate memory sharding is a lower bound. Per-rank weights, replicated KV, expert imbalance and collective buffers require runtime measurement.
Dense BF16 FLOPs are used for the illustrative prefill bound even when storage weights are FP8 or INT4. Storage precision does not prove compute speedup.
MoE batch union assumes uniform independent expert selection and homogeneous expert sizes. It is an explanatory scenario, not a routing predictor.
Uniform MLA KV byte width is not proof a chosen kernel stores every latent and RoPE element at that precision.
PTU normalization fields are manually editable teaching inputs and do not automatically identify a model, region, deployment or current quota.
